map.💡 公式：风险指数 = 运输时间 × 水温系数 × 密度系数 × 体型系数；存活: 💡 Formula: risk index = transport time × temperature coefficient × density coefficient × body size coefficient; survival rate = 100 − risk index × 0.5 (max 99.5%). The suggested density is solved from the full model: required density coefficient = 10 ÷ (time × temperature coefficient × body size coefficient), then × 100; if it is below the model floor of 0.3, 95% is unreachable and the time must be shortened or the water cooled — the page states this explicitly.
map.风险指数 = 运输时长 × 温度系数 × 密度系数 × 体重系数（密度系数 =: Risk index = transport hours × temperature coefficient × density coefficient × weight coefficient (density coefficient = max(density ÷ 100, 0.3), with a floor); estimated survival = 100 − risk index × 0.5 (clamped 0–99.5%). Suggested density is solved from the full model: set risk index = 10 (95% survival), so required density coefficient = 10 ÷ (hours × temperature coefficient × weight coefficient) and suggested density = 100 × that coefficient; 95% is reachable only when the result is ≥30 kg/m³ (density coefficient not at the 0.3 floor). Otherwise even the lowest density stays below 95%, and the page explicitly says that lowering density alone will not help.
map.密度系数 = max(密度 ÷ 100, 0.3)；体型系数 = 鱼体均重 ÷: Density coefficient = max(density ÷ 100, 0.3); body size coefficient = average fish weight ÷ 100 (capped 0.5–2.0). The density coefficient has a 0.3 floor, so lowering density further does not keep improving the model.

map.以 4 小时、18℃、草鱼种估算装载密度: Estimating loading density for 4 hours at 18°C with grass carp fry
map.草鱼种均重 50 g、水温 18℃、运输 4 小时：低温下代谢较低，开放式鱼篓允: Grass carp fry at 50 g average weight, water temperature 18°C, transport 4 hours: metabolism is lower at low temperature, and open fish baskets allow about 200~250 kg/m³; with sealed oxygen-filled bags and ice cooling to 12°C, density can be raised to 300~400 kg/m³. Beyond 6 hours or water temperature >25°C, the density must be lowered and aeration increased.
map.运输密度是不是越低越好？: Is a lower transport density always better?
map.并非越低越好。密度过低水体小、水质波动与鱼体碰撞应激反而大；应在保证溶氧与氨氮可: Not necessarily. Too low a density means a small water volume, and water quality fluctuations and fish collision stress become larger instead; the economic density should be chosen while ensuring dissolved oxygen and ammonia stay controllable. Generally short hauls use 200~300 kg/m³, and longer hauls with temperature control and oxygen can go higher; adjust for species and water temperature.
map.运输途中如何判断缺氧风险？: How to judge oxygen depletion risk during transport?
map.观察鱼浮头、狂游、体色发暗、聚集水面急促呼吸即为缺氧征兆。预防靠控制密度、持续增: Watch for fish surfacing, frantic swimming, darkened body color and gathering at the surface with rapid breathing - these are signs of oxygen depletion. Prevention relies on controlling density, continuous aeration (pure oxygen is better), cooling to lower metabolism, and periodic water exchange or topping up with fresh water on long hauls.
